title: Smoky German Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and comforting German noodle soup with a smoky twist, made with Vietnam-inspired flavors and fresh tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Smoky Noodles
ingredients.notes: Look for a smoky flavor in your noodles

instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the yellow tomatoes and cook for another 10 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook according to package instructions.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
